name: env_example
description: Turn a .env file given inline into a .env.example: every value blanked or replaced by a type hint (<url>, <number>, <boolean>, <email>, <host>, <path>, <secret>, <interpolated>, <string>), with comments, blank lines, the export prefix and the quoting kept. Flags duplicate keys, secret-looking keys that carry a value, values that look like AWS, GitHub, Slack, Stripe or Google keys, JWTs, PEM private keys or URLs with a password, and commented-out assignments. No input value is ever printed.

hints.description: true: a type hint in place of each value; false: empty values

output.example:
# App
export PORT=<number>
DATABASE_URL="<secret>"
DEBUG=<boolean>
PORT=<number>

duplicates.note: most loaders keep the last one

catalog.source: original; .env syntax as read by python-dotenv and docker compose (export prefix, quotes, inline comments, multi-line quoted values); token shapes from the providers' published key formats
